name: Medicine Ball (Rubber, ~6 kg look)
summary: Two-tone charcoal and teal textured rubber medicine ball with a small fill valve.
dimensions: 280 mm diameter per the task brief. Medicine balls have no universal competition diameter or density; the approximately 6 kg description is a visual size class, not measured mass or a certified standard.
construction: Editable UV sphere with broad teal equatorial band and charcoal poles. A 1024×512 tangent-space normal map sampled from a deterministic periodic height field supplies fine moulded grip texture. Small flattened black rubber fill valve at the front. Maps are original analytical bakes, not external images.
accuracy_notes: Diameter and two-tone treatment are generic. Grip grain is a normal map and does not alter the silhouette; the periodic moulded texture compresses near UV poles. The fill valve is a shallow geometric insert, without an internal passage. No mass, bounce, deformation or fill contents are simulated.
